entries.title: Griffin bypasses Boomi through direct outbound SFTP
entries.position: Keep the existing Griffin downloader unchanged. A separate WMS02 transfer job sends completed Excel files directly to Azure Blob over outbound SFTP for ISTP processing. Do not introduce a Boomi relay or an inbound SFTP server on WMS02.

entries.title: ISTP owns QAD staging and database writes
entries.position: The ISTP backend/background processor retrieves QAD / Pro2SQL data through Boomi's API/interface and persists it in ISTP-owned Azure SQL staging. Boomi must not write directly to ISTP SQL.

entries.title: ASN transport remains with Boomi
entries.position: Boomi delivers the original ASN *.JP1 file to Azure Blob; ISTP parses and processes it. Existing Boomi delivery or approved file-share pickup belongs to the Boomi integration design, not the Griffin direct-SFTP path.

entries.title: Business rules belong to ISTP, not transport integrations
entries.position: ISTP owns matching, validation, workflow and calculations. The ASP.NET Core API/Core handles business logic and application data access; background processing handles retrieval, inbound files and reconciliation.

entries.title: Generated exports are downloaded, not retained
entries.position: Generate ADC, TDC and Emergency Release files on demand for HTTPS browser download to the user's PC. Retain one current Emergency Release template in Azure Blob, but do not retain generated outputs in ISTP.

entries.title: Internal identity and authorization remain distinct
entries.position: Authenticate internal users with Microsoft Entra ID. Enforce role, permission and data-scope authorization in the API. Do not assume an external Entra/B2B pattern is approved for TDC.

entries.title: Application ingress must not bypass the approved WAF
entries.position: Protect application ingress with the approved HTTPS/WAF pattern and prevent direct application-origin bypass.

entries.title: Separate environments and service identities
entries.position: Keep DEV, TEST and PROD endpoints, identities, data and schedules isolated, with GitLab/Terraform promotion. Use managed identity for Azure access where supported and an approved service-to-service pattern for Boomi. Griffin SFTP requires least-privilege authentication, SSH host-key validation and controlled outbound connectivity.

entries.title: Recovery covers complete application data-platform loss
entries.position: Recover application/staging SQL data and retained raw files/templates through approved platform controls. Rebuild through controlled application artifacts and Terraform/GitLab; re-pull available QAD source data through Boomi. Generated exports are excluded from recovery.
entries.rationale: Generated outbound files are outside recovery because ISTP does not retain them.

entries.title: Legacy coexistence does not imply bidirectional synchronization
entries.position: GSCM/OCTS may operate alongside ISTP during transition. Do not assume automatic bidirectional synchronization between the legacy system and ISTP.

entries.title: Inbound interfaces expose operational health and retry
entries.position: Expose last success/failure, basic counts, freshness, errors and controlled retry/reprocessing for each inbound interface. Detailed retry policies and runbooks belong to interface operations documentation.

entries.title: External TDC identity and ingress remain a separate workstream
entries.position: An approved external TDC access architecture is still required. It may complete after Core ISTP; retain manual TDC export as the operational fallback until that solution is available.

entries.title: Business must assign coexistence data ownership
entries.position: Before go-live, Business must decide which system owns overlapping user-maintained records and fields while GSCM/OCTS and ISTP coexist. This document does not assign that ownership.

entries.title: Detailed QAD retrieval behavior is specified separately
entries.position: Avoid unnecessary recurring full loads. Endpoints, schedules and detailed retrieval behavior are delegated to interface specifications; their values and completion status are not established by this document.

entries.title: Retention durations and recovery targets belong to the recovery plan
entries.position: Retention durations and RPO/RTO targets are maintained in the operational recovery plan. This document does not provide their values or establish whether they have been approved elsewhere.
